chunking_adjudication.reason: A 256-root H3/3H iteration can exceed the GitHub-hosted single-job runtime limit. Collection is therefore checkpointed after each contiguous 64-root chunk, while Advantage fitting remains exactly once after the fourth chunk.
chunking_adjudication.equivalence_contract: The four chunks preserve the same global_root order, scenario-cycle order, production deck_seed(training_seed, global_root, iteration), collector RNG continuation, reservoirs, behavior models and iteration number that a single uninterrupted 256-root collection would use. No Advantage update occurs between chunks.

coverage_multiplier_rationale_frozen_bef.assumption_role: Planning heuristic only; it does not change or predict the admission gate.
coverage_multiplier_rationale_frozen_bef.variance_scaling_heuristic: For chance-dominated Monte Carlo variation, standard error is expected to scale approximately with 1/sqrt(N) before saturation or model effects.

two_x_nominal_projection.reason_rejected: Both projections remain above the unchanged 0.15/0.35 hard gates.

four_x_nominal_projection.reason_selected: Four is the first simple integer coverage multiplier in the 2x/4x sequence whose nominal projections fall below both unchanged hard gates.

decision_rule.stability_pass: All 8 training cells pass the original local training gates and all 8 representation x domain x evaluation-seed cross-seed rows pass mean TV <= 0.15 and p95 TV <= 0.35.
decision_rule.if_pass: This establishes a provisional stability remediation only. Freeze and run the complete original strategic Phase 2 evaluation on the x4 policies before selecting H2 or H3.
decision_rule.if_fail: Remain BLOCKED. No gate waiver. Freeze a further winner-independent chance-coverage stratification or larger-coverage experiment before another readmission attempt.
